bio.text: Sylvia R. Garcia was elected to the U.S. House in November 2018 and sworn in on January 3, 2019, representing Texas's 29th District.
She previously served as Houston City Controller, on the Harris County Commissioners Court, and in the Texas Senate beginning in 2013.
A native of Palito Blanco, Texas, she graduated from Texas Woman's University and earned her law degree at Texas Southern University's Thurgood Marshall School of Law.
